descent_coherence_floor.statement: On real Qwen3.8 activations (256 tokens, 6 layers, holdout 64), the cheap-to-reconstruct coherence floor is uniform-q3 at 3.25 BPW. No cheap in-register codec is both below 2.0 BPW and quality-intact.

next_cheap_rung.note: gate/up/attn_in stay >=0.90; L63 down_proj is the first organ to dip (0.843).

below_2p0_requires: a 1-bit organ (binary) on substantial mass — quality NOT intact at mid-depth
or a structured codec (HGRAVS01 two-stage on the wide down_proj, 0.13 BPW)
rice residual is a small quality bump over binary (~+0.04) and a reconstruction regression risk
descent_coherence_floor.q30_warning: Q30 lost coherence at <=1.5 BPW. binary_all at 1.42 is in that graveyard zone.
descent_coherence_floor.capture_limit: 256 tokens / 64 holdout. Organ cosine is a screen; generation is the gate. attn_out in-dim is 6144 and was weight-scored only.
